card.name: Pride, hubris and wealth themes
card.fires_on: Words in passages about pride, arrogance, hubris or showy wealth, often just before or inside a word like haughty, lavish, egotism or affluence.

modes.label: Pride and arrogance
modes.description: Spot just before or inside words about being haughty or self-important.
modes.example: David did not develop<< a>> haughty attitude.

modes.label: Wealth and luxury
modes.description: Partway through words about affluence or lavish display.
modes.example: Exulting in his aff<<lu>>ence, Pharaoh led an extravagant life

modes.label: Self-exaltation
modes.description: Words leading into phrases about becoming full of oneself.
modes.example: But lest we humans start<< getting>> full of ourselves for numbering 7 billion

card.writes: It lowers the odds of words like prosperous, flashy and fashionable, so it steers away from words about wealth and glamour.
card.plain: It notices text about pride and showy wealth, where the next word is likely to be about arrogance or luxury.
